meta.title: Cometary Vortex – 2
meta.description: O shining planets of the Milky Way, may you last forever.

units.rawText: Explosions and flames light up the endless night, while corpses and debris litter every inch of the world below.
units.displayText: Explosions and flames light up the endless night, while corpses and debris litter every inch of the world below.

spans.text: Explosions and flames light up the endless night, while corpses and debris litter every inch of the world below.

units.rawText: Entropization... can't be stopped￥%@... Don't want to become￥#&
units.displayText: Entropization... can't be stopped￥%@... Don't want to become￥#&

spans.text: Entropization... can't be stopped￥%@... Don't want to become￥#&

units.rawText: Fight￥%@... Protect... &home!!
units.displayText: Fight￥%@... Protect... &home!!

spans.text: Fight￥%@... Protect... &home!!

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: Faced with unstoppable entropization, the agent fighter chooses to end his life by detonating his core.
units.displayText: Faced with unstoppable entropization, the agent fighter chooses to end his life by detonating his core.

spans.text: Faced with unstoppable entropization, the agent fighter chooses to end his life by detonating his core.

units.rawText: Grah—
units.displayText: Grah—

spans.text: Grah—

units.rawText: The pack of entropics around him are engulfed by the explosion and are instantly reduced to glowing ash...
units.displayText: The pack of entropics around him are engulfed by the explosion and are instantly reduced to glowing ash...

spans.text: The pack of entropics around him are engulfed by the explosion and are instantly reduced to glowing ash...

units.rawText: Transmission irregularity from Area D Team 03. They aren't responding to hails.
units.displayText: Transmission irregularity from Area D Team 03. They aren't responding to hails.

spans.text: Transmission irregularity from Area D Team 03. They aren't responding to hails.

units.rawText: No longer detecting entropic contacts in the southern part of the base. We've confirmed that they've been completely eliminated.
units.displayText: No longer detecting entropic contacts in the southern part of the base. We've confirmed that they've been completely eliminated.

spans.text: No longer detecting entropic contacts in the southern part of the base. We've confirmed that they've been completely eliminated.

units.rawText: Titan has been infected with Entropy and there's no stopping the entropization of its crust. Those monsters might emerge again.
units.displayText: Titan has been infected with Entropy and there's no stopping the entropization of its crust. Those monsters might emerge again.

spans.text: Titan has been infected with Entropy and there's no stopping the entropization of its crust. Those monsters might emerge again.

units.rawText: All spaceships, maintain high altitude and avoid fighting near the surface.
units.displayText: All spaceships, maintain high altitude and avoid fighting near the surface.

spans.text: All spaceships, maintain high altitude and avoid fighting near the surface.

units.rawText: But what about Lady Xuannu...
units.displayText: But what about Lady Xuannu...

spans.text: But what about Lady Xuannu...

units.rawText: Area D Team 04, provide fire support and clear the entropics around Xuannu. What's the charge status for the Hellbore Cannon?
units.displayText: Area D Team 04, provide fire support and clear the entropics around Xuannu. What's the charge status for the Hellbore Cannon?

spans.text: Area D Team 04, provide fire support and clear the entropics around Xuannu. What's the charge status for the Hellbore Cannon?

units.rawText: Charge is at 20%. We used it to clear the entropics blocking our path when we entered the atmosphere, so we have to wait for it to recharge...
units.displayText: Charge is at 20%. We used it to clear the entropics blocking our path when we entered the atmosphere, so we have to wait for it to recharge...

spans.text: Charge is at 20%. We used it to clear the entropics blocking our path when we entered the atmosphere, so we have to wait for it to recharge...

units.rawText: Bring the ship over to Xuannu's location.
units.displayText: Bring the ship over to Xuannu's location.

spans.text: Bring the ship over to Xuannu's location.

units.rawText: Lady Xuannu is leading a team in battle against the entropic leader. The threat index of our destination is too high.
units.displayText: Lady Xuannu is leading a team in battle against the entropic leader. The threat index of our destination is too high.

spans.text: Lady Xuannu is leading a team in battle against the entropic leader. The threat index of our destination is too high.

units.rawText: This is the flagship of the Ringworld's forces. If the entropic leader brings it down, we'll lose a lot of fighting power.
units.displayText: This is the flagship of the Ringworld's forces. If the entropic leader brings it down, we'll lose a lot of fighting power.

spans.text: This is the flagship of the Ringworld's forces. If the entropic leader brings it down, we'll lose a lot of fighting power.

units.rawText: That monster's already entropized the entire moon. We can't beat her with an individual's strength.
units.displayText: That monster's already entropized the entire moon. We can't beat her with an individual's strength.

spans.text: That monster's already entropized the entire moon. We can't beat her with an individual's strength.

units.rawText: But if we expose the flagship...
units.displayText: But if we expose the flagship...

spans.text: But if we expose the flagship...

units.rawText: Kraken Mare.
units.displayText: Kraken Mare.

spans.text: Kraken Mare.

units.rawText: Yuwang points to a body of water on the map.
units.displayText: Yuwang points to a body of water on the map.

spans.text: Yuwang points to a body of water on the map.

units.rawText: The base is close to Kraken Mare. It's over 1000 feet deep, and if we submerge into the Kraken Mare, we can approach from underwater.
units.displayText: The base is close to Kraken Mare. It's over 1000 feet deep, and if we submerge into the Kraken Mare, we can approach from underwater.

spans.text: The base is close to Kraken Mare. It's over 1000 feet deep, and if we submerge into the Kraken Mare, we can approach from underwater.

units.rawText: While this vessel is submersible, it's not suited for extended underwater operations.
units.displayText: While this vessel is submersible, it's not suited for extended underwater operations.

spans.text: While this vessel is submersible, it's not suited for extended underwater operations.

units.rawText: We're just waiting for an opportunity to present itself. An opportunity to turn the tables...
units.displayText: We're just waiting for an opportunity to present itself. An opportunity to turn the tables...

spans.text: We're just waiting for an opportunity to present itself. An opportunity to turn the tables...

units.rawText: And staying underwater is better than being entropized. The survival of Jiutian hinges on this.
units.displayText: And staying underwater is better than being entropized. The survival of Jiutian hinges on this.

spans.text: And staying underwater is better than being entropized. The survival of Jiutian hinges on this.

units.rawText: All units, maintain current combat status. The flagship will submerge itself in the southern reaches of Kraken Mare and approach the base underwater!
units.displayText: All units, maintain current combat status. The flagship will submerge itself in the southern reaches of Kraken Mare and approach the base underwater!

spans.text: All units, maintain current combat status. The flagship will submerge itself in the southern reaches of Kraken Mare and approach the base underwater!

units.rawText: Yes sir!
units.displayText: Yes sir!

spans.text: Yes sir!

units.rawText: Titan, at the Jiutian Planetary Observation Base.
units.displayText: Titan, at the Jiutian Planetary Observation Base.

spans.text: Titan, at the Jiutian Planetary Observation Base.

units.rawText: Administrator, all combat units' operand expenditure has exceeded 60% while ammunition reserves are at 45%...
units.displayText: Administrator, all combat units' operand expenditure has exceeded 60% while ammunition reserves are at 45%...

spans.text: Administrator, all combat units' operand expenditure has exceeded 60% while ammunition reserves are at 45%...

units.rawText: All units with depleted ammunition are to rotate out and resupply. Send in the reserves!
units.displayText: All units with depleted ammunition are to rotate out and resupply. Send in the reserves!

spans.text: All units with depleted ammunition are to rotate out and resupply. Send in the reserves!

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: The beam saber clashes with the great sword once again. New scars appear on Caina's body and Xuannu's exo.
units.displayText: The beam saber clashes with the great sword once again. New scars appear on Caina's body and Xuannu's exo.

spans.text: The beam saber clashes with the great sword once again. New scars appear on Caina's body and Xuannu's exo.

units.rawText: Plasma field compression at 200%, stability at 65%.
units.displayText: Plasma field compression at 200%, stability at 65%.

spans.text: Plasma field compression at 200%, stability at 65%.

units.rawText: (So it seems a compressed plasma beam can hurt her.)
units.displayText: So it seems a compressed plasma beam can hurt her.

spans.text: So it seems a compressed plasma beam can hurt her.

units.rawText: (It can't kill her, though...)
units.displayText: It can't kill her, though...

spans.text: It can't kill her, though...

units.rawText: Yuwang, what's the status of the battle now?
units.displayText: Yuwang, what's the status of the battle now?

spans.text: Yuwang, what's the status of the battle now?

units.rawText: 35% of the landing force is no longer responding. We've lost five battleships from the fleet. We can't waste any more time.
units.displayText: 35% of the landing force is no longer responding. We've lost five battleships from the fleet. We can't waste any more time.

spans.text: 35% of the landing force is no longer responding. We've lost five battleships from the fleet. We can't waste any more time.

units.rawText: We can't hurt the entropic leader with normal weaponry.
units.displayText: We can't hurt the entropic leader with normal weaponry.

spans.text: We can't hurt the entropic leader with normal weaponry.

units.rawText: Under the circumstances, fighting on an individual level is unwise. Xuannu, lure the entropic leader to the main gate of the base in 5 minutes' time.
units.displayText: Under the circumstances, fighting on an individual level is unwise. Xuannu, lure the entropic leader to the main gate of the base in 5 minutes' time.

spans.text: Under the circumstances, fighting on an individual level is unwise. Xuannu, lure the entropic leader to the main gate of the base in 5 minutes' time.

units.rawText: What are you trying to— Ngh!
units.displayText: What are you trying to— Ngh!

spans.text: What are you trying to— Ngh!

units.rawText: <size=40>Wham!</size>
units.displayText: Wham!

spans.text: Wham!

units.rawText: Something pulls on Xuannu's exo with a tremendous force. The cockpit shakes violently and the transmission is forcibly terminated.
units.displayText: Something pulls on Xuannu's exo with a tremendous force. The cockpit shakes violently and the transmission is forcibly terminated.

spans.text: Something pulls on Xuannu's exo with a tremendous force. The cockpit shakes violently and the transmission is forcibly terminated.

units.rawText: Who the hell are you talking to? Getting distracted in a fight is a sure way to die!
units.displayText: Who the hell are you talking to? Getting distracted in a fight is a sure way to die!

spans.text: Who the hell are you talking to? Getting distracted in a fight is a sure way to die!

units.rawText: Lady Xuannu!
units.displayText: Lady Xuannu!

spans.text: Lady Xuannu!

units.rawText: The nearby agent fighters are surrounded by the enemy and can't rush to her side. A team of medical mini-robots who see Xuannu being flung around immediately hurl themselves into Caina's face.
units.displayText: The nearby agent fighters are surrounded by the enemy and can't rush to her side. A team of medical mini-robots who see Xuannu being flung around immediately hurl themselves into Caina's face.

spans.text: The nearby agent fighters are surrounded by the enemy and can't rush to her side. A team of medical mini-robots who see Xuannu being flung around immediately hurl themselves into Caina's face.

units.rawText: <size=40>AAAAAHHHH! Goddammit, where the hell did you maggots come from?!</size>
units.displayText: AAAAAHHHH! Goddammit, where the hell did you maggots come from?!

spans.text: AAAAAHHHH! Goddammit, where the hell did you maggots come from?!

units.rawText: Caina ignores Xuannu and proceeds to pick the mini-robots off her one by one before smashing them into the ground. Some don't even make it that far and are torn in half on the spot.
units.displayText: Caina ignores Xuannu and proceeds to pick the mini-robots off her one by one before smashing them into the ground. Some don't even make it that far and are torn in half on the spot.

spans.text: Caina ignores Xuannu and proceeds to pick the mini-robots off her one by one before smashing them into the ground. Some don't even make it that far and are torn in half on the spot.

units.rawText: Protect Lady Xuannu!
units.displayText: Protect Lady Xuannu!

spans.text: Protect Lady Xuannu!

units.rawText: The agents crash against Caina like a tide. Xuannu gets to her feet, then levels her plasma saber before stabbing right at Caina's heart.
units.displayText: The agents crash against Caina like a tide. Xuannu gets to her feet, then levels her plasma saber before stabbing right at Caina's heart.

spans.text: The agents crash against Caina like a tide. Xuannu gets to her feet, then levels her plasma saber before stabbing right at Caina's heart.

units.rawText: <size=40>Gwaaargh!</size>
units.displayText: Gwaaargh!

spans.text: Gwaaargh!

units.rawText:
The plasma saber penetrates Caina's body and Xuannu maxes out the exo's throttle, which throws up a cloud of dust that obscures everyone's vision.
 With a "bang!", she pins Caina to the ruined main gate of the base with her energy blade.
units.displayText:
The plasma saber penetrates Caina's body and Xuannu maxes out the exo's throttle, which throws up a cloud of dust that obscures everyone's vision.
 With a "bang!", she pins Caina to the ruined main gate of the base with her energy blade.

spans.text:
The plasma saber penetrates Caina's body and Xuannu maxes out the exo's throttle, which throws up a cloud of dust that obscures everyone's vision.
 With a "bang!", she pins Caina to the ruined main gate of the base with her energy blade.

units.rawText: (Coughs) You really don't know your limits... do you...
units.displayText: (Coughs) You really don't know your limits... do you...

spans.text: (Coughs) You really don't know your limits... do you...

units.rawText: You think this piddly thing is going to work against me?!
units.displayText: You think this piddly thing is going to work against me?!

spans.text: You think this piddly thing is going to work against me?!

units.rawText: Caina flings her arms wide and purple debris slowly melts into her body, healing her wounds.
units.displayText: Caina flings her arms wide and purple debris slowly melts into her body, healing her wounds.

spans.text: Caina flings her arms wide and purple debris slowly melts into her body, healing her wounds.

units.rawText: No, but this will.
units.displayText: No, but this will.

spans.text: No, but this will.

units.rawText: Splash—
units.displayText: Splash—

spans.text: Splash—

units.rawText: Before her eyes, the Kraken Mare swells and a massive vessel breaches the surface of its liquid methane waters. But what really grabs Caina's attention is the gigantic cannon that's pointing straight at her.
units.displayText: Before her eyes, the Kraken Mare swells and a massive vessel breaches the surface of its liquid methane waters. But what really grabs Caina's attention is the gigantic cannon that's pointing straight at her.

spans.text: Before her eyes, the Kraken Mare swells and a massive vessel breaches the surface of its liquid methane waters. But what really grabs Caina's attention is the gigantic cannon that's pointing straight at her.

units.rawText: Hellbore Cannon! Fire—
units.displayText: Hellbore Cannon! Fire—

spans.text: Hellbore Cannon! Fire—

units.rawText: A blinding light shoots forth from the cannon's muzzle, piercing through Caina's core.
units.displayText: A blinding light shoots forth from the cannon's muzzle, piercing through Caina's core.

spans.text: A blinding light shoots forth from the cannon's muzzle, piercing through Caina's core.

units.rawText: What the hell is... <size=40>AAAAHHHHHHHH—</size>
units.displayText: What the hell is... AAAAHHHHHHHH—

spans.text: What the hell is...
AAAAHHHHHHHH—

units.rawText: The blinding beam blasts through the dark purple skies, turning the night around the base into day.
units.displayText: The blinding beam blasts through the dark purple skies, turning the night around the base into day.

spans.text: The blinding beam blasts through the dark purple skies, turning the night around the base into day.

units.rawText: Caina clings to her last scraps of life as she lies upon the ground that has been charred black by the operand beam. She tries to reach out and gather the planet's operands for herself, but her ruined body won't listen to her commands.
units.displayText: Caina clings to her last scraps of life as she lies upon the ground that has been charred black by the operand beam. She tries to reach out and gather the planet's operands for herself, but her ruined body won't listen to her commands.

spans.text: Caina clings to her last scraps of life as she lies upon the ground that has been charred black by the operand beam. She tries to reach out and gather the planet's operands for herself, but her ruined body won't listen to her commands.

units.rawText: You have lost.
units.displayText: You have lost.

spans.text: You have lost.

units.rawText: I guess... I did...
units.displayText: I guess... I did...

spans.text: I guess... I did...

units.rawText: But you guys... messed yourselves up... so badly... just to beat me...
units.displayText: But you guys... messed yourselves up... so badly... just to beat me...

spans.text: But you guys... messed yourselves up... so badly... just to beat me...

units.rawText: There'll be... someone stronger... coming along... in... the future... Haha... ha...
units.displayText: There'll be... someone stronger... coming along... in... the future... Haha... ha...

spans.text: There'll be... someone stronger... coming along... in... the future... Haha... ha...

units.rawText: Then we'll just keep fighting.
units.displayText: Then we'll just keep fighting.

spans.text: Then we'll just keep fighting.

units.rawText: Splotch!
units.displayText: Splotch!

spans.text: Splotch!

units.rawText: With her throat pierced, all Caina can do is claw at her neck while making unintelligible noises. She struggles for a while, and then she finally stops moving. Once again, everything is silent.
units.displayText: With her throat pierced, all Caina can do is claw at her neck while making unintelligible noises. She struggles for a while, and then she finally stops moving. Once again, everything is silent.

spans.text: With her throat pierced, all Caina can do is claw at her neck while making unintelligible noises. She struggles for a while, and then she finally stops moving. Once again, everything is silent.

units.rawText: Jiutian... is victorious.
units.displayText: Jiutian... is victorious.

spans.text: Jiutian... is victorious.

units.rawText: As the battered agents around Xuannu hear her words, it takes a while for them to sink in. But soon, everyone realizes that the battle is over, and Jiutian sector will once again welcome a glorious tomorrow.
units.displayText: As the battered agents around Xuannu hear her words, it takes a while for them to sink in. But soon, everyone realizes that the battle is over, and Jiutian sector will once again welcome a glorious tomorrow.

spans.text: As the battered agents around Xuannu hear her words, it takes a while for them to sink in. But soon, everyone realizes that the battle is over, and Jiutian sector will once again welcome a glorious tomorrow.

units.rawText: <size=40>Jiutian... is victorious!</size>
units.displayText: Jiutian... is victorious!

spans.text: Jiutian... is victorious!
